channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Inside Hyperdrive: How we solved a rare Hyperdrive MySQL caching bug
item.description: While adding MySQL support to Hyperdrive, we found a subtle protocol bug when caching query results. Here is how we tracked down a 0.001% rate error and made Hyperdrive MySQL generally available. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare
item.description: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places. (6 sources: cloudflare, hackernews, javascriptweekly, lobsters, reactstatus, rprogramming)

item.title: Presentation: How to Find Resilience Bugs in Systems that Don't Exist
item.description: Hillel Wayne discusses how formal methods principles - such as property strength, state-space verification, and environment assumptions - help software engineers uncover critical architectural bugs early. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Article: Composable Commerce: Inside Shipt’s Kit Platform
item.description: Shipt launched its Kits feature, enabling quick assembly of themed grocery bundles for events. The platform architecture lets merchandisers easily create store-aware kits, streamlining previously labor-intensive workflows. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Under the hood, off the hot path: How D1 scales to millions of databases
item.description: A deep dive into how D1 architected its control plane to scale and manage millions of databases, while keeping data plane query operations at the edge. We share guiding principles on how to build on the Developer Platform effectively. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Rewinding the exponential: How we keep hardware usage down
item.description: Our strategies to optimize our data pipeline throughput without compromising data quality. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Cloudflares Newly Acquired Vite+ Reaches 1.0 with GitLab CI Support, Hooks, and tsup Migration
item.description: VoidZero has launched Vite+ 1.0, the first stable version of its JavaScript toolchain. It features a command line tool for managing Node.js, package management, and frontend development from a single configuration file. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: GitHub’s model for secret detection: Finding more secrets with less noise
item.description: GitHub’s context-aware secret classifier improves detection quality, raises weighted acceptance by 11.5%, and reduces median scan execution time by 86%. (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: The “alien” economics of AI monetization
item.description: As usage, costs, and customer expectations change, AI companies are moving beyond traditional SaaS pricing. (1 source: stripe)
